notes: ILLUSTRATIVE — the core anti-trust case. This checker looks excellent on the CHEAP metrics: near-zero spurious findings (0.03), single-pass (loop 0), fast (5s), deterministic. Its raw weighted number lands GREEN (87). But it missed 2 of 10 ground-truth labelled defects (miss_rate 0.20), so HIGH_MISS_RATE fires and forces the disposition to UNRELIABLE / effective band red. A high number can never buy back a checker that passes real breaches.
